KNOWN FALSE, the uniqueness half of RTI_BN: x = +inf, r = NaN meets it (is_finite and Bsign of the NaN are false), and Bnearbyint gives +inf (READ and model, reported, ext-work/p2/a/rti32/draft3/PLANTS.md). Refused in dn_unique where that conjunct is used (MEASURED, own)

inf-sign-flip.what: RTI_DN's sign clause flips the sign of an infinite result only (line 87). Refused in rf_dn_self, the infinite case, not in rf_dn_fin (MEASURED, own, rehearsal)
